name: Hendrik Nicolas Carlo
tagline: I turn research-grade models into software people can actually use.
bio: Computer Science undergraduate and Apple Developer Academy graduate specializing in applied AI, computer vision, and ML deployment — bridging research-grade models with production iOS apps and cloud infrastructure.
about: I am a passionate software engineer with a strong focus on applied AI, computer vision, and machine learning deployment.

During my time at the Apple Developer Academy, I learned how to bridge the gap between research-grade models and production-ready applications, delivering real-world value through intuitive interfaces and robust infrastructure.
I'm always eager to learn new technologies, tackle complex problems, and build experiences that make a difference.

competencies.name: Python
competencies.description: Extensive experience in building robust backend services, data pipelines, and deploying deep learning models using PyTorch and FastAPI.

competencies.name: Swift
competencies.description: Proficient in SwiftUI and UIKit. Built and shipped production iOS applications with seamless Core ML integrations.

competencies.name: TypeScript
competencies.description: Strong command of modern web development using Next.js, React, and building performant, type-safe full-stack applications.

focus.label: Current focus
focus.body: Right now that means JKTDrive — a benchmark for vision-language models on Jakarta traffic, where weaving motorcycles, informal right-of-way and ambiguous markings break the assumptions most driving datasets are built on.
